sv.title: Must-chef: Så kan Ryssland dra nytta av det svenska snökaoset
sv.summary: Det har varit bombhot, drönarlarm och cyberangrepp som skapat oro runt om i Europa den senaste tiden. Flera aktörer har varnat för att den typen av attacker skulle öka och det är det vi nu ser, menar Must.

en.title: Must chief: How Russia can benefit from the Swedish snow chaos
en.summary: There have been bomb threats, drone alerts and cyberattacks that have caused unease around Europe recently. Several actors have warned that that type of attack would increase, and that is what we are now seeing, says Must, the military intelligence service.
